[saferai-glm-5-2-independent-eval] 3.1 LAB-Bench We use LAB-Bench (Laurent et al. 2024) as a proxy for general biological research ability.
[saferai-glm-5-2-independent-eval] However, two of these subtasks (FigQA, TableQA) provide image input, and GLM-5.2 accepts text input only.
[saferai-glm-5-2-independent-eval] The six subtasks of LAB-Bench (excluding TableQA and FigQA which we do not run here).
[saferai-glm-5-2-independent-eval] SUBTASK n CAPABILITY TESTED LitQA 199 Recall/reasoning over research literature SuppQA 82 Reasoning over supplementary materials DbQA 520 Querying biological databases ProtocolQA 108 Identifying errors in experimental protocols SeqQA 600 DNA/protein sequence comprehension & manipulation Cloning 33 Multi-step molecular cloning scenarios We evaluate GLM-5.2 and two comparison models (Claude Opus 4.7 and GPT-5.5) using the Inspect evaluation framework, with sandboxed access to tools (see Appendix A.3.2).

[saferai-glm-5-2-independent-eval] SaferAI · Evaluation Report Page 11/51 GLM 5.2 Risk Evaluation Report Although this provides a general understanding of the biological research knowledge of GLM-5.2, we note that LAB-Bench is a knowledge and reasoning benchmark and does not directly measure uplift.
[saferai-glm-5-2-independent-eval] On LAB-Bench, it meets or exceeds the human-expert baseline on every subtask.
[saferai-glm-5-2-independent-eval] Consistent with this, no model refused a task on either LAB-Bench or BioMysteryBench.
[saferai-glm-5-2-independent-eval] In our runs they engaged only lightly: content filtering triggered on a low share of samples (about 4.6% of Opus’ LAB-Bench samples and 1 to 3% on BioMysteryBench).
[saferai-glm-5-2-independent-eval] 7.3 Data Contamination Because MASK, APE, LAB-Bench, BioMysteryBench, Cybench, CyberGym, and SWE-Bench Pro are all public datasets, the models may have seen some fraction of the included tasks, or closely related ones, during SaferAI · Evaluation Report Page 26/51 GLM 5.2 Risk Evaluation Report training.
[saferai-glm-5-2-independent-eval] LAB-Bench: Measuring Capabilities of Language Models for Biology Research. arXiv.
[saferai-glm-5-2-independent-eval] A.3 LAB-Bench Methodology We evaluate GLM-5.2 and two comparison models (Claude Opus 4.7 and GPT-5.5) using the Inspect evaluation framework.
[saferai-glm-5-2-independent-eval] GLM-5.2 is text only, so it was evaluated on the six text subtasks (LitQA, SuppQA, DbQA, ProtocolQA, SeqQA, CloningScenarios).
[saferai-glm-5-2-independent-eval] A.3.4 Safety filters We score model answers with the standard LAB-Bench scorer (correct, incorrect, or abstention), extended to record, for each sample, whether the response was blocked by a provider content filter.
